title.purpose: Page headings, card section titles, modal headers.

body.purpose: Primary content, descriptions, form field values. Max 65–75ch for prose.

label.purpose: Button text, navigation items, form labels, badge copy.

caption.purpose: Timestamps, secondary metadata, helper text below fields.

mono.purpose: Technical strings: IDs, file paths, config values.

shadows.name: card-default-dark
shadows.purpose: Default card elevation in dark mode. Subtle teal edge + ambient glow + depth anchor.

shadows.name: card-outlined-dark
shadows.purpose: Outlined card in dark mode. Lighter teal edge for bordered containers.

shadows.name: card-elevated-dark
shadows.purpose: Elevated card in dark mode. Modals, popovers, command palettes.

shadows.name: card-outlined-light
shadows.purpose: Outlined card in light mode. Minimal structural shadow.

shadows.name: card-elevated-light
shadows.purpose: Elevated card in light mode. Standard floating panel.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: All UI state transitions: background-color, color, opacity, box-shadow.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions. No bounce, no elastic.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action. Used for the single most important action on any given surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background-color: var(--color-primary); color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--color-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background-color: var(--color-primary-active); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-surface-bg), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-primary); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action. Sits alongside a primary button; lower visual weight.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background-color: var(--color-surface-panel); color: var(--color-text-primary); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: var(--color-surface-bg); color: var(--color-text-primary); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-surface-bg), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-border); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action. Delete, disconnect, or irreversible operations only.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background-color: var(--color-danger); color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background-color: var(--color-danger-hover); } .ds-btn-danger:active { background-color: var(--color-danger-active); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-surface-bg), 0 0 0 4px var(--color-danger); } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card (Default)
components.description: Standard container. Panel surface + teal ambient glow in dark mode.
components.html:
Card Title

Card content goes here. This is what the default card looks like at rest.
components.css: .ds-card-default { background-color: var(--color-surface-panel); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-default); background-image: var(--card-glass-highlight); transition: box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--color-text-primary); margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--color-text-secondary); margin: 0; }

components.name: Card (Outlined)
components.description: Outlined container variant. Explicit border for edge definition.
components.html:
Outlined Card

Use this variant when edge definition matters more than depth.
components.css: .ds-card-outlined { background-color: var(--color-surface-panel); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-card-outlined); border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-outlined); background-image: var(--card-glass-highlight); } .ds-card-outlined .ds-card-title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--color-text-primary); margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-card-outlined .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--color-text-secondary); margin: 0; }

components.name: Badge (Primary)
components.description: Read-only teal badge. Status indicator or category label.
components.css: .ds-badge-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; background-color: rgba(13, 148, 136, 0.10); color: var(--color-primary); border: 1px solid rgba(13, 148, 136, 0.20); border-radius: 9999px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Badge (Status)
components.description: Status badge showing success/warning/error states using the 10%/20% opacity formula.
components.css: .ds-badge-success, .ds-badge-warning, .ds-badge-error { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 0.25rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 9999px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-success { background-color: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.10); color: #10b981; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.20); } .ds-badge-warning { background-color: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.10); color: #f59e0b; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.20); } .ds-badge-error { background-color: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.10); color: var(--color-danger); border: 1px solid rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.20); }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation item. Active state carries teal fill; inactive items are subdued.
components.css: .ds-nav-demo { background-color: var(--color-surface-panel); padding: 0.75rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 4px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item--active { background-color: var(--color-primary); color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-item--inactive { color: var(--color-text-secondary); } .ds-nav-item--inactive:hover { background-color: var(--color-surface-bg); color: var(--color-text-primary); } .ds-nav-item--inactive:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--color-primary); } .ds-nav-icon { flex-shrink: 0; width: 1.25rem; height: 1.25rem; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input. Border-focus pattern, no floating label.
components.html: The base URL for your Sonarr instance.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.375rem; } .ds-field-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; color: var(--color-text-primary); } .ds-input { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; background-color: var(--color-surface-bg); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0.375rem; color: var(--color-text-primary); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-muted); } .ds-field-hint { margin: 0; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--color-text-muted); }

narrative.overview:
Warden is a control surface for the self-hosted media stack. Users arrive with a task and leave with it done. The interface is designed to disappear: dark surfaces that reduce eye strain during long sessions, teal reserved for where the system is alive (active states, live indicators, primary actions), and information density calibrated for operators who know what they are looking at.

The design is dark-first. Not dark as aesthetic flourish — dark as the designed experience. Three surface tiers (bg / panel / elevated) create hierarchy through tonal separation rather than decoration. Cards lift from the background by stepping one tier toward the light. The teal ambient glow in dark mode — layered inset edge highlights and wide ambient diffusion — signals elevation and focus, not ornament.

Warden should feel at home beside Tautulli, Kometa, and Overseerr — tools that take their job seriously and don't perform friendliness they don't mean. It is not a Servarr app and carries no arr design debt; it has its own hierarchy, its own authority, and its own level of craft.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first: dark mode is the designed experience, not a theme variant
Teal as signal: the accent appears only where the system is active or responsive
Three surface tiers: bg / panel / elevated, enforced by tonal separation and shadow depth
Dense by default: information at a glance; whitespace earns its place
Confident and minimal: clear affordances, no surface decoration without function

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal appears on ≤10% of any given screen at rest. An interface where everything is teal is an interface where nothing is teal. Its rarity is its power.

rules.name: The No-Warm-Surface Rule
rules.body: No cream, sand, beige, or warm-tinted neutrals. The floor and panel are cool slate. Warmth is carried by the teal accent and its glow, not by background tinting.

rules.name: The Scale Constraint Rule
rules.body: No fluid (clamp) typography. This is a product UI used at consistent DPI. Fixed rem values only. A heading that shrinks inside a sidebar is not responsive design.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: No display fonts, no decorative pairing. Inter carries every role. Weight contrast (400 to 600) and size contrast (12px to 20px) are the hierarchy tools.

rules.name: The Teal Glow Rule
rules.body: The ambient glow is calibrated to Console Black (#0f172a). Never increase teal opacity beyond the elevated card values; above that threshold, the glow reads as a rendering artifact, not an elevation signal.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest in light mode. Shadows appear as structural differentiation or state response, never decoration.

dos: Do use teal exclusively for primary actions, active selections, and live status indicators.
Do use the three-tier surface system (bg / panel / elevated) as the primary hierarchy tool. Every container belongs to one tier.
Do use the exact shadow vocabulary from Section 4. The multi-layer teal glow is calibrated; substituting generic drop shadows breaks the elevation language.
Do keep Inter as the sole UI typeface. Weight and size contrast create hierarchy; additional fonts add noise.
Do cap prose line length at 65–75ch. Dense data views may run longer; descriptions and help text must not.
Do include all six states on every interactive component: default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading.
Do use cursor: not-allowed and 40% opacity for disabled states on every component variant.
Do verify contrast for every new surface-text pairing. Minimum: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large or bold text and interactive elements.
donts: Don't use a cream, sand, or warm-neutral body background. This is the most common AI-generated aesthetic of 2025-2026 and reads immediately as generic.
Don't model the visual identity on Sonarr, Radarr, or any Servarr app. Warden is not a Servarr app; it has no arr suffix, no arr inheritance, and no obligation to inherit arr design patterns.
Don't build a monitoring dashboard. No metric-hero cards, no chart-heavy grid layouts. Warden is a task automation tool, not Grafana.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient). Prohibited. Solid teal or solid white only.
Don't use side-stripe accents (border-left or border-right greater than 1px in a brand color). Use full borders, background tints, or status badges instead.
Don't use display or decorative fonts in UI labels, buttons, nav items, or table cells.
Don't apply teal as a background fill to more than 10% of screen area at rest.
Don't default to modals. Inline editing, contextual side panels, and progressive disclosure are almost always better.
Don't animate layout properties (width, height, padding, margin). All state transitions use only background-color, color, opacity, transform, and box-shadow at 150ms.
Don't gate content visibility on entrance animations. Content must be visible by default.
